title: Format core: .seeds JSONL reader/writer + round-trip compat suite vs sd 0.5.15
description:
First product seed: the format core everything else builds on.

Deliverables:
- Reader/writer for the .seeds/ store (config.yaml, issues.jsonl,
  plans.jsonl, templates.jsonl) in crates/seeds.
- Data model: seed records with id <project>-<hex4>, title, description,
  status (open/in_progress/closed), type, priority, labels, assignee,
  timestamps, blockedBy dependency arrays.
- Unknown record fields MUST be preserved on every write (read-modify-
  write, verified live against sd 0.5.15: additive fields survive update
  and close).
- Round-trip compat suite: our writer writes, sd 0.5.15 reads + updates,
  our fields survive; and inverse direction. This suite is the crate's
  acceptance gate (README compat contract, ADR-0023 in denkhaus/fabro).

Acceptance:
- cargo nextest green incl. round-trip suite
- `sd show` and our reader agree on every record of this repo's own
  .seeds/issues.jsonl (593-record-scale real fixture is the denkhaus/fabro
  tracker, not this file set — synthetic fixtures plus this tracker)

PRIOR ATTEMPT (2026-09-26, rescue pointer — START FROM THIS WORK):
Run 01M2ZW7TT6KK (17:00 fire, three implementer passes) produced a
gate-green format core on branch origin/fabro/run/01M2ZW7TT6KKBR8RSS60ZBSEDR
(~1739 insertions, 14 files: crates/seeds/src/store.rs reader/writer,
tests/compat.rs + tests/roundtrip.rs + real sd-list fixture
tests/fixtures/repo_issues_sd_list.json + more). The run died ONLY
because the toolchain image lacked python3 (fixture battery shells out;
image fixed + repinned as ghcr.io/denkhaus/seeds-toolchain:a395e00d3c46
— qualitygate verified GREEN locally against that branch). A fork
attempt (01M2ZXJ6) reused the stale python3-less sandbox and a
continuation (01M2ZXJ3) crashed its worker — both dead ends, engine
follow-ups filed in the fabro repo. IMPLEMENTER: check out that run
branch (or cherry-pick its diff vs 6be5dd6) as your starting point,
verify the round-trip suite still passes, and complete whatever the
brief still lacks — do NOT re-derive from zero.

title: real_fixture test: volatile-field drift breaks PR #1 CI (fixture vs moving tracker)
description:
PR #1 (format core) is CI-red on one test: real_fixture
`our_reader_agrees_with_sd_on_every_repo_record` —
`field updatedAt of seeds-facc differs between sd and our reader`
(fixture 2026-09-20T17:52:48Z vs repo file 14:06:18Z). 15/16 green.

ROOT CAUSE (diagnosed from the CI log): the checked-in fixture
(tests/fixtures/repo_issues_sd_list.json) was captured DURING the run,
after the run's own sd experiments/claim had bumped tracker state; the
tracker file on the PR branch carries older values. The test design
compares a static snapshot against a MOVING target — any run that
mutates the tracker between fixture capture and CI breaks it.

FIX DEMAND: make the real-fixture equivalence test insensitive to
volatile fields — compare per record only stable fields (id, title,
type, priority, labels, blockedBy) and normalize/exclude volatile ones
(updatedAt, status, assignee) — or regenerate the fixture from the
branch's own tracker in a prepare step. The volatile-field set belongs
in one named constant with a comment explaining the drift class.

NOTE: this blocks PR #1 (first seeds merge) — the fix must land ON the
PR branch (run branch fabro/run/01M2ZYVQ7CBS...), not on main, because
main does not carry the format core yet.

title: seeds dedupe: native tracker heal command (report + --write, gate-friendly)
description:
Native command: `seeds dedupe` — heal duplicated tracker records
(beyond sd parity; ADR-0023 additive own-development, demanded by the
2026-09-26 fabro tracker-corruption incident: sd sync's wholesale
rewrite makes issues.jsonl merge-hostile, git line-merges produced 596
duplicate ids on the fabro line via run-PR squashes; the ad-hoc python
union recipe ran four times in one session).

SEMANTICS (reference recipe, commit denkhaus/fabro e58fd06e8):
- One record per id: keep the record with the NEWEST updatedAt (tie:
  later line position wins); preserve first-seen line order otherwise.
- Operates on .seeds/issues.jsonl AND plans.jsonl / templates.jsonl
  (same record-id rule per file).

CLI SHAPE:
- `seeds dedupe` — report mode: prints per-file duplicate summary
  (id, count, kept updatedAt, dropped updatedAts) and EXITS 1 when
  duplicates exist, 0 when clean. CI/gate-friendly: usable directly as
  a qualitygate battery.
- `seeds dedupe --write` — applies the heal in place (atomic temp-file
  + rename), prints the recipe summary, exits 0; idempotent (clean file
  = no-op, exit 0).
- `seeds dedupe --json` — machine-readable report for the loop scripts.

INTEGRATION DEMANDS (cross-repo):
- fabro's fabro-4cfc guard (qualitygate duplicate-id battery +
  push-gate HEAD check) should CALL `seeds dedupe` once this lands,
  replacing the ad-hoc python recipe (bootstrap: the python recipe
  stays until the CLI parity surface ships).
- Later surface: `fabro seeds dedupe` (subcommand integration per
  ADR-0023 fabro-seeds wiring).
- Adjacent follow-up (NOT this seed): canonical-order write mode
  (sorted, append-friendly serialization) to make merges trivial —
  separate seed once the format core settles.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Fixture with duplicated ids: report mode exits 1 with correct
  summary; --write produces the union-newest single-record file
  (byte-verified against the recipe's output for the same fixture).
- sd 0.5.15 reads the healed file unchanged (round-trip suite green).
- Clean file: both modes exit 0, no rewrite (--write must not touch
  an already-clean file).

title: Quality gate: derive touched crates from crates/<name>/** in qualitygate.nu and verify.nu
description:
Consolidated multi-arm seed (revisor, subsumes open overflow line 14 of 01M2ZYVQ7CBSY3T0FEYBE9JK74.md).

Arm 1 — scripts/qualitygate.nu (lines 51,58): touched-crate detection filters on the ported-from-fabro 'lib/(?:apps|components|foundation)/' layout, which matches nothing in this repo's crates/<crate>/ layout. Derive touched crates from 'crates/<name>/**' (keep the lib/ arms for portability). Effect: 'just qualitygate' actually runs clippy+nextest per touched crate; a red suite can no longer ship through a green gate (run 01M30FZ05QPQNMTYPWHKPJBE8J diff was entirely crates/seeds/tests yet the gate printed 'no crates touched' and finished green in 5.6s; correctness held only because the implementer hand-ran the suite).

Arm 2 — scripts/verify.nu (lines 73-75,82): same lib/-based detection; 'just verify implementer' printed 'no lib/ crates touched — nothing to verify' on the same all-Rust diff. Apply the same crates/<name>/** derivation and count test-file touches when deriving crates (is-test-file already exists in verify.nu).

Arm 3 — loud failure: fail the gate when the diff touches *.rs but the derived crate set is empty, so a future layout change can never silently no-op the gate again.

Basis: run 01M30FZ05QPQNMTYPWHKPJBE8J, workflow version e3c92fec9a9a6fd9256277d60e06e12dddcacf6779280c9df5c2b2825b813ea8, commit 7327f84768922f5c3c6ec1054280275bceb6e95a

title: Reviewer node: make rust-style-guide readable (use_skill or fs_hide exemption)
description:
The develop reviewer prompt makes reading .fabro/skills/rust-style-guide/SKILL.md binding policy before judging Rust diffs, but the stage's tools resolved to glob, grep, read_file, request_user_input only (no use_skill; the skills dir is fs_hide-bound), so the reviewer approved the Rust diff real_fixture.rs without the guide (run 01M30FZ05QPQNMTYPWHKPJBE8J reviewer journal; tool_time 2ms).

Capability-affecting (ADR-0019): this changes tool availability on an agent-reachable surface (node tool allow-list / fs_hide binding). implementation awaits explicit user approval. Proposed fix directions are engine-mediated, read-only, extend-existing-tools only: (a) add use_skill to the reviewer node's tools allow-list in the develop workflow graph, or (b) exempt .fabro/skills/** from fs_hide for reviewer read tools. Effect: the standards axis becomes mechanically auditable; guide violations route Changes-requested instead of depending on model memory.

Basis: run 01M30FZ05QPQNMTYPWHKPJBE8J, workflow version e3c92fec9a9a6fd9256277d60e06e12dddcacf6779280c9df5c2b2825b813ea8, commit 7327f84768922f5c3c6ec1054280275bceb6e95a

APPROVED by user (2026-09-21, seeds session): reviewer must be able to read the
rust-style-guide — implementation unblocked. Both proposed directions (a) use_skill
allow-list, (b) fs_hide exemption for .fabro/skills/** remain open; implementer picks.

title: dup-run-check: default base origin/main, not origin/denkhaus (stale fabro port)
description:
Three stale `denkhaus`-branch references survive the port from
denkhaus/fabro; this repo's merge target is `main` (PROJECT_FACTS,
branch protection on main, run PRs integrate into main).

FIX DEMAND:
1. `.fabro/scripts/dup-run-check.nu:209` — default `--base` is
   `"origin/denkhaus"`; change to `"origin/main"`. Effect: the bare
   documented invocation (implementer preflight, revisor Step 3.5)
   stops degrading with `fatal: couldn't find remote ref denkhaus`.
   Today only planner-preflight's explicit `--base` keeps the script
   functional; every bare call is a guaranteed degraded no-op.
2. `.fabro/scripts/dup-run-check.nu:9` — usage comment claims
   `origin/denkhaus` IS the FACTS merge-target branch; fix to
   `origin/main`.
3. `.fabro/scripts/push-gate.nu:3` — comment quotes directive
   "NEVER push to denkhaus while a pass runs"; the guarded line here
   is `main`. Comment-only, same drift class.

BASIS: run 01M2ZYVQ journal/review (finding #6), 01M30FZ05 review
(finding #2), 01M31EVY review + revision ledger ("Fix dup-run-check
default base to origin/main", withheld as overflow-dup against the
01M2ZYVQ overflow line — no seed existed, user demanded action
2026-09-21).
